description: Header file defining the SecurityAgent class and related nested classes for a plugin system, including authentication, token management, configuration, and directory monitoring.

classes.name: SecurityAgent
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing authentication, web, JSONRPC, and plugin interfaces.

classes.name: TokenDispatcher
classes.description: Handles communication and token dispatching for authentication.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container for ACL, connector, and DAC settings.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: JSON container for token payload data.

classes.name: DirectoryCallback
classes.description: Monitors directory changes and loads ACLs from files.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves security interface associated with a token.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles web request processing and response generation.

methods.name: endpoint_validate
methods.description: Validates a token or security request.
